name: Modified DSMZ #63 mineral medium + fructose (PMC5447228)
description: Modified DSMZ #63 mineral medium + fructose — medium reported in PMC5447228, extracted for GrowthDB and mapped to BiGG.

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC5447228 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Composition mapped to BiGG (mapper + salt dissociation); presence-based bounds; paper_amount retained. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.verification: paper-verified (complete recipe; cited + supplementary sources chased)
provenance.verification_evidence: Modified from DSMZ recipe #63 ... NaHCO3, 2.6 g (per liter)
provenance.base_medium: DSMZ mineral medium #63 (Desulfovibrio fructosovorans medium), modified; SL-10 trace elements + DSMZ/Wolin vitamin solution #141

sources_chased.what: Paper main text methods (D. fructosovorans medium, modified from DSMZ #63)
DSMZ vitamin solution #141 (Wolin's vitamin solution) composition

recuration.notes: Complete recipe recovered for the modified DSMZ #63 D. fructosovorans medium plus 10 mM fructose. SL-10 (1 mL/L) and DSMZ/Wolin vitamin solution #141 (10 mL/L) fully expanded from DSMZ media 320 and 141. Anaerobic, bicarbonate-buffered under 80% N2/20% CO2, reduced with 1.5 g/L sodium ascorbate. MgCl2 hydration state not specified in the paper (mM given assumes anhydrous; hexahydrate would be ~9.8 mM). No selenium in this medium (Se only in the separate DMSS-1 medium).

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
